office.prompt: Create a production pixel-art beat-em-up sprite sheet using the reference ONLY for the character identity, outfit, palette and pixel style. Transparent background. EXACT layout 4 columns by 8 rows, 32 separate full-body poses, evenly spaced equal cells, no text no grid lines. Every character faces RIGHT in side/three-quarter view. Fixed camera, consistent anatomy, body scale and ground line across each row. Each row is a four-frame attack: windup, anticipation, full extension CONTACT, recovery. Row 1 quick lead jab. Row 2 opposite-arm cross punch with torso twist. Row 3 heavy barehand hook punch. Row 4 quick front kick. Row 5 turning roundhouse kick. Row 6 high finishing kick. Row 7 crouching low sweeping kick, one hand planted on floor and leg fully extended along floor at contact; NO slide or forward dive. Row 8 crouch then explosive UPWARD UPPERCUT holding OBJECT in striking hand, visibly raising the object from waist to above head at contact. Do not draw explosions or trails; effects are separate in engine. Keep full silhouette and all props safely inside each cell. 1024x2048 portrait sheet. REFERENCE CHARACTER: Gomelo: black hair, beard, sunglasses, navy blazer white shirt gray trousers white sneakers. Elegant precise boxing and kicks. OBJECT = a silver smartphone firmly held in fist.
